purpose: Teach: 一寸/やむなく/専ら/例える/かねてから/しなやか/でたらめ/おとなしい

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、一寸ノート貸してくれ
lines.en: Riku, can you lend me a notebook for a second?
lines.style: Direct, casual demand with a hint of urgency. Quick opening. No please — they're comfortable enough for it. Slight snap at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト中、やむなく答え書けなかったろ、桜
lines.en: You didn't write down any answers during the test though, did you, Sakura?
lines.style: Wry half-smile in the voice. Leans back slightly. Not accusing — noting a fact he's amused by. Gentle teasing that lands because they know each other.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、専らゲームに使ってんなお小遣い
lines.en: You're just using your allowance for games anyway, aren't you?
lines.style: Deflecting with sarcasm. Quick counterattack. Lighter than it sounds — this is how they talk. No real bite underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、勉強を山登りに例えるる事で言ってたな、桜
lines.en: Didn't you say studying was like climbing a mountain or something?
lines.style: Softer shift. Reflective but not heavy. Drawing on something she remembers he said. Testing whether he remembers too. Quiet observation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、かねてから美術部入りたいって言ってたな
lines.en: You've been saying for ages you wanted to join the art club.
lines.style: Same reflective tone. Switching subjects — moving from teasing into something she's actually noticed about him. Not pushy, just stating it like evidence.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、しなやかに走るな、桜
lines.en: You run pretty gracefully, you know.
lines.style: Unexpected shift into genuine praise. Almost awkward saying it out loud. Sincere but covered in a light tone so it doesn't land too heavy. Quick delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、でたらめな答え書くなよ
lines.en: Don't just write down random answers, okay?
lines.style: Back to directness but softer now. Not nagging — genuinely concerned underneath. The tone of someone telling a friend something that matters. Steady eye-level.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、教室ではおとなしいよな、桜
lines.en: You're quiet in class, though. Like, you don't say much.
lines.style: Wry observation at the close. Light, almost teasing again, but the door is open — asking without asking. Trailing slightly. Giving him space to answer or not.
